# Intangible Asset Valuation Engine

> A complete intangible asset valuation library implementing 124+ functions from the *Intangible Asset Valuation* textbook — Python library, MCP server, and AI-agent skills.

Live site: https://intangible-valuation.simonmak.com
Remote MCP: https://intangible-valuation.simonmak.com/api/mcp
Package: https://pypi.org/project/intangible-valuation/
MCP Registry: io.github.simonmak-ascent/intangible-valuation
Repository: https://github.com/simonmak-ascent/intangible-valuation
